_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/casting/test_playable_until_next_exile.py. Never part of a deck list. `t_foes_impulse` is Superior Foes of Spider-Man's trigger without its optional 'may' (trample left off too): every spell of mana value 4 or greater exiles the top card, playable until the creature exiles another. `t_foes_big_spell` is the four-mana spell that fires it.

cards.name: Test Foes Impulse
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 4 or greater, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card until you exile another card with this creature.

abilities.text: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 4 or greater, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card until you exile another card with this creature.
